app.name: Janata Darbar
app.office: Office of the Forest Minister, Maharashtra

setup.title: Add your name
setup.body: Your name is recorded with every token and every edit.

resume.title: Finish the open scan
resume.body: {n, plural, one {# page already photographed} other {# pages already photographed}}

scan.label: Scan an application
scan.hint: Photograph each page. The token is issued straight away.

capture.title: Scan pages
capture.tip: Lay the page on a darker surface and fit all of it in the frame, including the signature and mobile number.

scan.notFound: The page edges weren't found. Use “Adjust corners” to straighten it.
scan.cornersHint: Drag the four circles onto the page's corners
scan.lookHint: Scan whitens the paper and removes shadows. Use Photo for photographs and ID pictures.

token.title: Token issued
token.citizen: Take a photo of this screen. Use this number and your mobile number to check the status of your application.
token.pages: {n, plural, one {# page received} other {# pages received}}
token.saved: Saved on this phone. It uploads and is read in the background — check it from the queue.

queue.title: Queue
queue.empty: Nothing scanned on this phone yet.
queue.offline: Offline. Scans are saved and upload when the signal returns.
queue.timeout: The signal is too weak to finish uploading. It will try again automatically.
queue.pendingBadge: {n, plural, one {# scan waiting to upload} other {# scans waiting to upload}}
queue.deleteLocalConfirm: Delete this scan from this phone? It has not been uploaded, so it will be lost.

verify.title: Check details
verify.notOnServer: Not on the server yet. It may still be uploading from the phone that scanned it.

reading.title: Reading the pages
reading.body: Usually under 30 seconds. The citizen already has the token and does not need to wait.

failed.title: The pages could not be read

attention.title: {n} details need checking
attention.body: Compare these with the letter before saving.
attention.none: Everything was read clearly. Still compare the details with the letter.

verify.unreadable: Words that could not be read
verify.confirm: I have checked these details against the letter.
verify.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved until you confirm.

limit.title: Your AI limit for today is reached
limit.body: Each person can run {n} AI readings a day. Another staff member can read it, or enter the details by hand.

limitTotal.title: Today's overall AI limit is reached
limitTotal.body: All staff together can run {n} AI readings a day. Enter the details by hand, or read again tomorrow.

onSpot.label: Resolved on the spot by the Minister
onSpot.hint: Tick this if it was settled at the Darbar. It is still routed and recorded, then closed straight away.

mobile.label: Mobile number
mobile.invalid: Not a valid 10-digit mobile number. The SMS will not be sent.
mobile.missing: No mobile number. The citizen will not get an SMS.

saved.title: Saved and sent to the department

sms.label: SMS to the citizen
sms.logged: Pilot: recorded, not sent — SMS templates are awaiting approval.
sms.skipped: Not sent — no valid mobile number.

rescan.title: Rescan pages
rescan.body: Retake a blurred or cut-off page, add a missed page, or remove a wrong one. The token stays the same.
rescan.note: The current reading is replaced, and the rescan is recorded in the history.
rescan.timeout: The signal is too weak to finish

track.title: Application status

mobile.label: Mobile number
mobile.hint: The number written on your application

track.notFound: The token and mobile number do not match. Check both and try again.
track.error: The status could not be checked right now. Try again later.
track.privacy: Your details are used only to act on your application.

settings.title: Settings

staff.label: Your name
staff.hint: Recorded with every token and every edit.

hints.label: Show English labels under fields
hints.hint: Helps when staff read Marathi and English.
hints.englishOnly: English labels under fields are shown only when the app is in Marathi or Hindi.

autoCrop.label: Straighten pages and remove shadows
autoCrop.hint: Finds the page edges, straightens the page and whitens the paper. You can adjust each page.

settings.offline: The server cannot be reached. Scanning still works and uploads later.
settings.pilot: Pilot: use sample or redacted letters only.

login.title: Staff sign-in
login.body: Sign in with your mobile number and the password you were given.
login.invalid: The mobile number or password is not correct.
login.notConfigured: Sign-in is not set up on this server. Ask the administrator.
login.error: Could not sign in right now. Try again.
login.citizen: Checking an application? Use the status page.

inApp.title: Open this in Chrome
inApp.body: You are inside {app}. The camera and offline saving work reliably only in Chrome.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Scanning still works. Photos are saved on this phone and upload when the signal returns.

sms.tokenReceived: Janata Darbar: Your application has been received. Token {token}. Check status: {url} - Office of the Forest Minister, Maharashtra

seal.ring: Janata Darbar ✦ Forest Minister's Office ✦ Maharashtra ✦

archive.title: Archive {token}?
archive.body: It leaves the queue and the counts. It stays on record and can be restored.
archive.noteHint: For example, the token it duplicates.
archive.routedWarning: This was already sent to the department, and an SMS may have gone to the citizen.

archived.title: Archived — {reason}
archived.deleteConfirm: Delete {token} permanently? Its record and page photos are removed from the server. This cannot be undone.

record.resolvedOnSpot: Resolved on the spot at the Darbar

case.title: Department follow-up
case.onBehalf: Record what the department did. In the pilot, office staff record it on the department's behalf.
case.remindNote: The reminder is recorded in the timeline. Sending it by SMS or email starts once those are switched on.
case.transferNote: The new department's response time starts today.

timeline.received: Received at the intake desk; token issued
timeline.aiFailed: AI could not read the pages
timeline.edited: {n, plural, one {# detail corrected by staff} other {# details corrected by staff}}
timeline.smsLogged: Token SMS recorded (not sent in the pilot)
timeline.smsSkipped: No SMS — no valid mobile number
timeline.resolvedOnSpot: Resolved on the spot by the Minister

apps.title: Cases
apps.empty: No application has been routed yet. They appear here once staff check and save them.
apps.subject: Subject

dash.title: Dashboard
dash.sub: All Darbar sessions, updated every minute.

brief.title: Briefing for the Minister
brief.sub: A short read-out of these figures in English and Marathi, ready before the next Darbar. Uses one AI reading.
brief.limit: Your AI limit for today is reached.
brief.limitTotal: Today's overall AI limit is reached.
